record.paper_title: Some open problems in low dimensional dynamical systems
record.original_question: Let f(t) be a continuous, nonzero, T-periodic function and let p > 0. Find necessary and sufficient conditions on f ensuring that the singular differential equation x(t)^p xʺ(t) = f(t) has positive T-periodic solutions.

evidence.quote: Problem 9. Let f(t) be a continuous T periodic function, f(t)̸≡0 and 0 < p∈R. Find necessary and suﬃcient conditions on the function f that ensure the existence of positiveT periodic solutions of xp(t)x′′(t) =f(t).

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $T>0$ and $p>0$ be real numbers, and let $f:\mathbb{R}\to\mathbb{R}$ be a continuous, $T$-periodic function with $f\not\equiv 0$. Consider the singular second-order ordinary differential equation
$$x(t)^{p}\, x''(t) = f(t).$$
A positive $T$-periodic solution is a function $x\in C^{2}(\mathbb{R})$ such that $x(t+T)=x(t)$ and $x(t)>0$ for all $t\in\mathbb{R}$, satisfying the equation pointwise.

Determine necessary and sufficient conditions on $f$ (in terms of its sign, mean value, and other integral or qualitative properties) under which the equation admits a positive $T$-periodic solution.
artifact.status_search_result: The literature on singular second-order periodic problems (Lazer–Solimini and successors) provides various sufficient conditions and, for some closely related equations such as $x'' + a(t)/x^\alpha = h(t)$, sharp necessary-and-sufficient mean-value conditions. However, no complete necessary and sufficient characterization of $f$ for the equation $x^p x'' = f(t)$ to admit positive $T$-periodic solutions appears in the searched sources, and this question is posed as an open problem in low-dimensional dynamics surveys. Status appears open.

status_evidence.title: Existence of positive periodic solutions for Liénard equations with an indefinite singularity of attractive type
status_evidence.snippet: Lazer and Solimini obtained that a necessary and sufficient condition for the existence of positive periodic solutions is ∫₀ᵀ h(s)ds > 0 (weak singularity) or < 0 (strong singularity).
status_evidence.claim: Sharp necessary-and-sufficient conditions are known for related but different singular periodic equations, not for x^p x'' = f(t).

status_evidence.title: Periodic Positive Solution to a Class of Singular Second-Order Ordinary Differential Equations
status_evidence.snippet: Existence results for positive periodic solutions of singular second-order ODEs.
status_evidence.claim: Existence (sufficient) results exist; a complete characterization for x^p x'' = f(t) is not established.
